answer: Model attestations as a weighted graph and propagate trust with bounded-length random walks, so each pulse of endorsement decays with path length rather than multiplying unchecked. A sybil group may forge many identities, but if its links to honest nodes form a sparse cut, its low conductance limits incoming walk probability. Min-cut and transitivity bounds then cap the cluster’s aggregate voting weight; a terrace of linked identities cannot substitute for independent external ties.
